requirements.statement: For each area (<area>) of an informative image map that has a text alternative, outside the particular cases, the alternative is relevant.

citations.quote: d’une image réactive porteuse d’information, ayant une alternative textuelle, cette alternative est-elle pertinente (hors cas particuliers) ?
vérifier que l’alternative textuelle est pertinente

routes.statement: Each source present is relevant: the alt attribute, the title attribute, the aria-label attribute and the passage of text linked by aria-labelledby.

citations.quote: S’il est présent, le contenu de l’attribut `alt` est pertinent
S’il est présent, le contenu de l’attribut `title` est pertinent
S’il est présent, le contenu de l’attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-label` est pertinent
S’il est présent, le passage de texte associé via l’attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-labelledby` est pertinent
Pour une image porteuse d’information, l’alternative textuelle apporte l’information nécessaire à la compréhension du contenu qu’elle véhicule

exceptions.statement: An image used as a CAPTCHA or as an image-test: criterion 1.3 is not applicable to it; criterion 1.4 treats it.

citations.quote: lorsque l’image est utilisée comme CAPTCHA ou comme image-test
le cas des CAPTCHA et des images-test est traité de manière spécifique par le critère 1.4.

rationale.text: Relevance is judgment: code cannot decide whether a text gives the information an image carries. Whether an image carries information, and whether it is a CAPTCHA or an image-test, are judgment too. So no check can fault an alternative as surely irrelevant on an element surely in scope, nor pass a page, and the entry stays at none. The wording lists the sources and asks that each one present be relevant ("S’il est présent"), not only the one the accessible-name order selects; the entry models this as one requirement with one route that names every source. The particular case of criterion 1.3 is an exception: CAPTCHA and image-test images, which criterion 1.4 treats. The elements are the areas of an image map, clickable or not, as the glossary of an area says. The glossary notes on links and buttons are not listed as exceptions here: they speak of an image that is the only content of a link or a <button>, and an <area> is neither. Whether the alternative of a clickable area is also evaluated as a link text in the links theme is not said in this test's text; this entry claims nothing either way. No axe rule is tagged and no custom check is registered: every sign of irrelevance that code could find would be evidence only. Applicability is judgment, because the test applies only to images that carry information and are not CAPTCHA or image-test. Needs is empty: the methodology asks for no assistive technology. The glossary says that where the name computation is only partly supported, the value assistive technologies really render is the alternative; that matters for which text is judged, not for whether the test can be examined, and at none nothing is concluded.

citations.quote: Image qui véhicule une information nécessaire à la compréhension du contenu auquel elle est associée.
Pour une image porteuse d’information, l’alternative textuelle apporte l’information nécessaire à la compréhension du contenu qu’elle véhicule
c’est la valeur réellement restituée par les technologies d’assistance utilisées dans l’environnement de test (ou « base de référence ») qu’il faudra considérer comme alternative textuelle
Zone cliquable ou zone non cliquable d’une image réactive côté client ou zone cliquable d’une image réactive côté serveur.
